trigger_cases.prompt: Create a sitemap and global navigation model for our e-commerce platform.
Design the category taxonomy and faceted search metadata schema for our documentation hub.
Audit user wayfinding and breadcrumb hierarchies to reduce navigation drop-offs.
Tune CSS transition durations for hover states.

binary_cases.prompt: Design the navigation hierarchy and wayfinding system for a multi-product SaaS portal.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Delivers global/local navigation model, controlled vocabulary labels, and clear wayfinding cues (Where am I, What can I do next).
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Establish a 3-tier navigation hierarchy with descriptive labels, breadcrumb wayfinding, controlled vocabulary, and clear category labeling.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Place 50 unstructured links into a single dropdown menu with cryptic acronym labels.
